newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iwasaki Elec sees portion of loan unrecoverable.
newsitem.headline: Iwasaki Elec sees portion of loan unrecoverable.

text.p: Iwasaki Electric Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it may not be able to recover a portion of a 294 million yen loan it extended to a electric equipment retailer based in Nagano.
The firm, Showa Denki Sangyo, applied for court protection under Japan's bankruptcy laws on June 30, Iwasaki Electric said in a statement.
The amount of the loan accounted for 97.3 percent of Iwasaki Electric's parent net profit in the year to November 1996, the statement said.
Iwasaki Electric said that it would announce a revised earnings forecast following the Nagano firm's failure.
